svg.text: Rear height datum: Blender 14 vs Blender 15

Exact vertical sections through each port axis of the saved meshes, frame 1. Revision 15 raises the I/O board (and the audio nuts) so its component mounting plane sits on the original DXF 0.250 in (6.350 mm) datum.
Case front is left, outside is right. Nominal illustration geometry; not a physical-fit qualification.
PJ-202AH power (POWER0) — Blender 14: mounting plane 6.269 mm above plate edge
body bottom 0.081 mm below cutout edge
mesh overlap with plate 1.148 mm³ (contact threshold 0.01)
PJ-202AH power (POWER0) — Blender 15: mounting plane 6.350 mm above plate edge
body bottom on cutout edge (within 0.001 mm)
mesh overlap with plate 0.000 mm³ (contact threshold 0.01)
USB-B envelope (USB0) — Blender 14: mounting plane 6.269 mm above plate edge
body bottom 0.081 mm below cutout edge
mesh overlap with plate 1.536 mm³ (contact threshold 0.01)
USB-B envelope (USB0) — Blender 15: mounting plane 6.350 mm above plate edge
body bottom on cutout edge (within 0.001 mm)
mesh overlap with plate 0.000 mm³ (contact threshold 0.01)
